newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN SYNERGIA PLANS EURO NM DEBUT ON MAY 26.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN SYNERGIA PLANS EURO NM DEBUT ON MAY 26.

text.p: Belgian Synergia said on Monday it wanted to raise up to 470 million francs through a share issue paving the way for its debut on the new small capitalisation market in Brussels on May 26.
Synergia, a holding company specialised in buying companies in financial trouble, said it would issue 645,000 new shares within a price range of 610 to 730 francs per share.
"This capital increase should allow Synergia to finance its further expansion," it said in a statement.
Existing shareholders will hold 50.2 percent of total capital after the issue which will boost the number of shares to 1,295,000.
The issue should raise a minimum of 393 million francs, it said.
"The operation started today and the bourse listing is planned for May 26," it said.
